Up to $190 off Beats headphones, the 240W Beats USB-C cable from $19, and more awaits below.

iPhone 17 Pro up to $290 off list prices via Amazon renewed right now

This morning we are circling back around to the deals that have started to pop recently on Amazon renewed iPhone 17 Pro units. It has taken a little bit longer this generation for Amazon to serve up notable discounts on Apple’s latest Pro-grade iPhone, but they are here and you can score up to $290 off the list price right now.

It is going to be a while before iPhone 17 Pro units appear in the official Apple refurb store, and even once they do Amazon tends to have much lower prices anyway. There are no 17 Pro units in the Apple refurb store yet, but you can land up to $290 off in Amazon renewed condition right now and a few off the Cosmic Orange and the 1TB Deep Blue model have now dropped even lower:

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,123 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,108 (Reg. $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,210 (Reg. $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,269 (Reg. $1,499)

As a quick reminder, you will want to make sure you are specifically looking at the units shipped and sold by/from Amazon. There are plenty of them on there from less than desirable sellers, and it can get confusing when Amazon auto switches the listing on you as you’re flipping through the colors and storage options. The links above should direct you to the best listings at the best prices.

Score Dad an Apple Watch this year starting down at $219 shipped

Dad’s big day is closing in quickly and the Apple Watch deals are still flying if you’re looking to strap one of Apple’s latest releases on his wrist at a discount this weekend. The entry-level SE 3 models are starting down at $219 for more casual tech Dads, but you’ll also find the latest Apple Watch Series 11 with at least $100 in savings and deals from $299 on all colors still live right now as well.

Apple Watch Series 11 deals

At the time of writing, Amazon is shipping just about all Series 11 models with overnight delivery for Prime members. There are deeper deals on the high-end Titanium models at up to $160 off right now, but the more popular aluminum variants are down at $299 for the 42mm and $329 for the larger 46mm case size, delivering $100 in savings. There’s also still a solid $130 discount on the aluminum 46mm GPS + Cell model for Dads that want the always connected experience too:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $299 (Reg. $399) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499) – All colors
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $329 (Reg. $429) – All colors
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529) – All colors

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Titanium $609 (Reg. $749)

Rare $300 price drop hits this M5 Pro MacBook Pro with nano-texture display today

It rare to catch any deals on the new M5 Pro MacBook Pro with the nano-texture upgrade. And while they might not be the most popular configurations, we wanted to make sure this $300 price drop on the 24GB/1TB model was on the radar.

B&H is now offering the 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM, 1TB storage, and the nano-texture display upgrade down at $2,548 shipped.

You can’t buy this exact configuration from Amazon and most big box retailers where all of the best deals tend to be, but this same machine will cost you $2,849 straight from Apple. Today’s deal delivers a rare chance to score one at $300 off.

Amazon does, however, have this same M5 Pro without the nano-texture upgrade down at $2,529 right now. That’s $170 off, the regular $2,699 list price, but the nano glass is worth an extra $150 from Apple and we have seen Amazon’s config down as low as $2,449 already this year.

Again, the display upgrade isn’t going to be for everyone, and there are almost certainly some notable Prime Day deals looming on the models Amazon carries, but you’re not going to find this nano model there anyway.

If you’re on the hunt for a particularly generous Dad’s Day or Grad gift without spending nearly this much, Amazon is delivering all MacBook Neo models well ahead of Father’s Day from $590 for Prime members:

  • MacBook Neo Citrus 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Citrus 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

  • MacBook Neo Blush 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Blush 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 sitting down at Amazon all-time low pricing ahead of Father’s Day

While AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 or AirPods 4 at $99 make for a brilliant Dad’s day gift, if you’re looking to go big this year, or perhaps score Apple latest over-ears for yourself, the Amazon all-time low pricing on AirPods Max 2 is still rolling.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 down at $499 shipped – this is the lowest price they have ever sold for in brand new condition since release.

Regularly $549, you’re looking at a solid $50 in savings and Amazon all-time low pricing.

There was a time when Best Buy’s open-box deals presented a notable chance to save some cash on these things for early adopters, but the prices are hardly lower than Amazon’s ongoing all-time lows right now. At the time of writing Best Buy is charging full price for Max in brand new condition.

There is of course a chance we see them drop even lower for Prime Day next week, but that’s not going to be much good if you’re looking to land a set for Dad, and it’s hard to imagine them dropping all that much lower than this. Something like $479 isn’t out of the question but a full $100 off would be a wild price drop this soon after release on Apple’s flagship over-ears.

The first truly next-generation set of AirPods Max, the set we are featuring here today deliver up to “1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than original AirPods Max,” alongside enhanced adaptive audio and transparency modes, Conversation Awareness tech, Live Translation support, and more.
